meta.name: options
meta.description: Compare feasible approaches to a customer problem and recommend a path with costs, constraints and evidence. Use for an architecture or delivery decision, not implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较几种可行方案,列清成本与限制,帮你选定一条路线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在动手前先把几种做法的成本与风险摆清楚再定方向
copy.tagline_en: Compare feasible approaches, weigh costs and constraints, and recommend a path.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must choose a direction before committing to build.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会针对客户问题对比几种可行方案,给出带成本、约束和依据的推荐路径;它面向架构或交付决策,不做具体实现。
howto.when: 当你要做架构或交付决策时接管,而不是写实现代码;若由 @fde 调用,会复用其当前已清洗的材料与范围。

say.text: 对比这三种架构方案,给出推荐路径和成本
say.note: 产出带成本与约束的方案对比

say.text: 这个交付决策有哪些约束?对比可行做法
根据现有材料推荐一条方案,并说明依据
say.note: 推荐附带证据,保留未知项

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude compares feasible approaches to a customer problem and recommends a path with costs, constraints and evidence. It serves architecture or delivery decisions, not implementation.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you face an architecture or delivery decision rather than an implementation task; when called by @fde it reuses that sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Compare these three architecture options and give a recommended path with costs
say_en.note: Produces an option comparison with costs and constraints

say_en.text: What constraints apply to this delivery decision? Compare the feasible approaches
say_en.note: Focuses on trade-offs in the delivery path

say_en.text: Recommend one option from the current material and state the evidence
say_en.note: Recommendation comes with evidence; unknowns are preserved
